# Skill: Mobile UX

Target: iPhone Safari/Chrome and compact desktop.

Checks:
- safe-area-inset-top/bottom is respected;
- minimum practical touch target is 44px for primary interactive controls;
- keyboard does not hide STEN composer or unlock action;
- no horizontal page overflow;
- fixed/sticky elements remain usable with browser chrome;
- mobile navigation opens/closes deterministically and Escape/backdrop behavior is safe;
- tables can scroll inside their own container instead of widening the page.
